embeds.title: 🔴 SHub macOS Infostealer Variant Spoofs Apple Security Updates
embeds.description:
SentinelOne researchers identified a new variant of the SHub macOS infostealer, dubbed Reaper, that uses AppleScript to display fake Apple security update messages and install a backdoor. The malware steals browser data from multiple browsers, cryptocurrency wallet information, password manager credentials, and files from Desktop and Documents folders. Unlike earlier SHub campaigns using ClickFix tactics, Reaper bypasses Apple's Terminal mitigations by using the applescript:// URL scheme. Users were lured through fake installers for WeChat and Miro applications hosted on spoofed domains.
**Sources:** BleepingComputer • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** none • **Access:** Malicious websites hosting fake installers for WeChat and Miro applications, luring users to download and execute malware
